nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes:
=== CONFIGURATION ===
Edit the values above to configure:
- MSA_CRITERIA_FILE_ID: Google Drive file ID for MSA criteria PDF
- SUBMARKET_CRITERIA_FILE_ID: Google Drive file ID for Sub-Market criteria PDF

PDF generation uses PDF Noodle API (configure credentials separately)

httpHeaderAuth.name: PDF Noodle API Header Auth account
